result.definition: Participants applied selection/keep-remove decisions using explicit thresholds that prioritize respectful, non-insulting dialogue while removing profanity, name-calling, hate, threats, or violence endorsement.
result.salience_notes: The shared logic across reflections is a tone/harm/discourse criterion centered on civility (avoid vitriol/expletives/insults) plus hard exclusions for hateful or threatening/violent content.
